review_candidates.description: BUSCAMOS CLOUD ENGINEER - AWS Experiencia: 2 años o más en roles de infraestructura cloud, DevOps o administración de sistemas, con foco en AWS. Requisitos obligatorios - Core Cloud Networking AWS: diseñar una VPC completa (subnets públicas y privadas, route tables, Internet/NAT Gateway, Security Groups, NACLs). IAM y seguridad: definir roles y policies con mínimo privilegio, gestionar accesos multicuenta con IAM Identity Center, cifrar con KMS, manejar secretos con Secrets Manager/Parameter Store y aplicar el modelo de responsabilidad compartida. Cómputo y bases de datos: desplegar y operar EC2, Auto Scaling, Load Balancers y RDS/Aurora. Saber dimensionar instancias, gestionar parches y planificar mantenimientos. Infraestructura como código: haber declarado y desplegado un entorno completo (red, cómputo, permisos, variables por entorno) con Terraform, CloudFormation o equivalente, con manejo de estado remoto y módulos reutilizables. Observabilidad con CloudWatch o equivalente: definir métricas, alarms y dashboards propios, centralizar logs y diagnosticar un incidente con información incompleta. Respaldo y continuidad: configurar AWS Backup, snapshots y replicación entre regiones, y definir objetivos de recuperación (RPO/RTO) según la criticidad del servicio. Contenedores: Docker, ECR y ECS/Fargate. Construir imágenes, desplegar servicios y configurar escalamiento. CI/CD y automatización: construir pipelines de despliegue (GitHub Actions, CodePipeline o equivalente) y automatizar tareas operativas con Python, Bash o AWS CLI. Uso de agentes de IA para infraestructura (Claude Code, Kiro, Codex o equivalentes): definir instrucciones al agente, decidir qué contexto necesita, usar skills, subagentes o MCP, y validar el resultado (IaC, scripts, diagnósticos) con un criterio explícito antes de aplicarlo. Fundamentos complementarios (nivel básico) ·     Serverless: Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, SQS, SNS y EventBridge. ·     Gobierno y costos: AWS Organizations, SCPs, etiquetado, Cost Explorer y Budgets. ·     Seguridad gestionada: GuardDuty, Security Hub, AWS Config, CloudTrail y WAF. ·     Buenas prácticas: pilares del AWS Well-Architected Framework. ·     Deseable: certificación AWS (Solutions Architect Associate, SysOps Administrator o equivalente).   ¿Deseas postular? Envíanos tu CV al correo veronika.angulo@applying.cloud hasta el viernes 30 de octubre a las 6pm, indicando en el asunto: CARGO + PRETENSIONES ECONÓMICAS. (INDISPENSABLE)

review_candidates.title: Senior SATCOM Engineer
review_candidates.description: At MITRE, your passion fuels work that impacts our nation and improves lives. This is where your skills strengthen national security, cybersecurity, health, transportation, and citizen services. We’re a nonprofit engineering, applied research, and advanced technology organization working in the public interest. With objectivity and integrity at our core, we lead federally funded research and development centers for U.S. government agencies – collaborating with industry and academia to deliver integrated, high-impact solutions that advance our nation’s health, security, and prosperity. Our people tackle the toughest technical challenges, supported by competitive benefits, meaningful career development, and a culture of innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence. Choose MITRE for a career with purpose — and help shape the future. Department Summary: As an operator of Federally Funded Research and Development Centers (FFRDCs), MITRE staff are tasked with applying their skills to impact programmatic and technical decisions of highest importance to the nation. The Advanced Wireless & SATCOM Department which is part of the MITRE Technology and Engineering Infrastructure, Networking, and Communications Division, has as its mission to provide premier communications network engineering services for our customers at all classification levels. Our engineers have expertise in research, design, analysis, modeling and simulation, lab experimentation, field testing, and implementation of networks across a diverse set of networked communication environments including virtual, wired, and wireless. We are adept at combining networking research and innovation with practical hands-on experience to provide risk reduction and deployable solutions for our customers. We seek to expand our department with staff capable of performing SATCOM communications network engineering tasks. They should have a fundamental understanding of and interest in networking protocols and principles, as well as the desire to learn more and focus in this area. Roles & Responsibilities: Specific duties will vary by project but will generally include a combination of research, design, analysis, testing, experimentation, modeling & simulation, and emulation of communications networks to solve our nation’s most complex problems. Those activities will include one or more of following: Support building & maintaining lab-based testbeds and conducting proof-of-concept experiments Conduct field trials Model performance and behavior of networks in tactical environments Work with cyber and infrastructure automation technologies Research emerging technologies Assist MITRE staff in analyzing, modernizing, and advancing sponsor work programs If a specific project requires skills or knowledge of technologies with which you are unfamiliar, your responsibilities will also include reaching back to fellow network research engineers across the MITRE corporation to bring their expertise to bear. Basic Qualifications: Typically requires a minimum of 5 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 3 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with relevant experience who can immediately contribute at this job step; or equivalent combination of related education and work experience. Strong foundational knowledge of TCP/IP networking fundamentals and OSI stack, including wireless networking and modern network security Expertise in one or more emerging edge networking technologies including but not limited to proliferated LEO (pLEO) satellite communications, mesh networking, edge computing platforms, network encryption, etc. Expertise in tactical network architecture, including direct understanding of operational deployment processes and challenges; including familiarity with DoW tactical networks Possess excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills Work well in a collaborative team environment with inter-disciplinary and geographically dispersed teams Willingness to expand into and master network protocol, technology and skill areas listed above with which the candidate may not yet have experience Must have an active Top Secret U.S Government issued Security Clearance. Per the U.S. Government’s eligibility requirements, you must be a U.S Citizen to be considered for a security clearance. This position requires a minimum of 3 days per week on-site. Preferred Qualifications: Strong interpersonal and leadership skills to effectively lead collaboration efforts across multiple organizations and engineering disciplines Expertise in all or most of the following technology areas: satellite communications systems (including pLEO and MEO/GEO), mesh networking, edge computing platforms, cyber security solutions, network resiliency, and software-defined networking (SDN) Experience with systems engineering processes for networking systems, e.g. requirements development/review, V&V, etc. Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a Top Secret/SCI U.S Government issued Security Clearance. Per the U.S. Government’s eligibility requirements, you must be a U.S Citizen to be considered for a security clearance. This requisition requires the candidate to have a minimum of the following clearance(s): Top Secret This requisition requires the hired candidate to have or obtain, within one year from the date of hire, the following clearance(s): Top Secret/SCI Salary compensation range and midpoint: $118,000 - $147,500 - $177,000 Annual Work Location Type: Onsite Commitment to Non-Discrimination All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local or international law. review_candidates.title: Customer Support Engineer (Lisbon, Portugal)
review_candidates.description: About Spin.AI Spin.AI is a SaaS security company headquartered in Palo Alto, CA, protecting organizations against SaaS ransomware, data loss, data leaks, risky third-party apps, and compliance gaps across their mission-critical SaaS applications. SpinOne is an all-in-one SaaS security platform that brings together backup and disaster recovery, ransomware detection and response, data loss prevention (DLP), and SaaS security posture management (SSPM) for Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Salesforce, and Slack. With the acquisitions of Revyz (backup and recovery for Atlassian Jira and Confluence) and DoControl (SaaS data loss prevention), Spin.AI continues to expand its coverage of the SaaS stack. More than 1,500 organizations worldwide trust Spin.AI to protect their data. Learn more here. Position Summary: We are looking for an experienced, technically strong, customer-obsessed Customer Support Engineer to support our European customers. You will be the first technical point of contact for IT administrators, security teams, and MSP partners, helping them get the most out of the Spin.AI platform—from onboarding and configuration to troubleshooting backups, restores, security alerts, and integrations. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, explaining technical concepts clearly, and building trust with customers. You will work closely with our Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and Sales teams, and your feedback will directly shape the product and our knowledge base. This role is based in our Lisbon, Portugal office. You will work from the office during the week, and weekend work is done remotely. Hours follow European business hours, with some overlap with our US-based teams. What You Will Do: Provide technical support to customers and partners via email, chat, and video calls, meeting response and resolution SLAs. Research, diagnose, and resolve issues across Spin.AI products, including backup and restore, ransomware protection, DLP, SSPM/app risk assessment. Troubleshoot integrations with Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Salesforce, Slack, including admin consoles, OAuth/API permissions, and service accounts. Guide new customers through onboarding, setup, and best-practice configuration. Reproduce issues, gather logs and evidence, and escalate to Engineering with clear, well-documented tickets; follow through until resolution. Manage and document cases accurately in our ticketing system (Jira Service Management), ensuring proper recording and closure of all issues. Write and maintain knowledge base articles, FAQs, and internal tech notes. Act as the voice of the customer—share recurring issues, feature requests, and product feedback with Product and Engineering. Partner with Customer Success and Account Management on adoption, renewals, and at-risk accounts, and flag expansion opportunities you spot in customer conversations. Prepare timely reports on support trends and contribute ideas to improve support processes and tooling, including AI-assisted support. What You Bring: 4+ years of experience in technical support, IT support, or a customer-facing engineering role, ideally at a B2B SaaS company, with a track record of owning complex technical escalations from start to finish. Hands-on administration experience with Google Workspace and/or Microsoft 365 (Entra ID, Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams). Working understanding of SaaS and cloud concepts such as APIs, OAuth, SSO/SAML, user and permission models, and data retention. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work through ambiguous issues methodically. Excellent written and spoken English (C1 or higher) and the ability to explain technical topics to both technical and non-technical audiences. Excellent client-facing skills, empathy, and a sense of ownership for the customer outcome. Self-motivated and organized, able to work independently, both in the office and remotely on weekends, and prioritize multiple issues in a fast-paced setting. Curiosity and willingness to learn the platform deeply in order to deliver fast, effective support. Based in Lisbon, Portugal, or willing to relocate, and eligible to work in Portugal. Nice to Have: Experience with Salesforce, Slack, or Jira. Background in cybersecurity, data protection, backup/recovery, or DLP. Certifications such as Google Workspace Administrator or Microsoft 365 Administrator. Scripting or technical tooling skills (e.g., PowerShell, Python, REST API tools like Postman). Experience with Jira Service Management, Planhat, or similar support and CS tools. Additional European languages (e.g., German, French, Spanish, Italian). Experience supporting MSPs or channel partners Room to Grow: We invest in our people and want this role to be a launchpad. Depending on your strengths and interests, there is a clear path to grow into: Customer Success Manager (CSM): own a portfolio of customer relationships, drive adoption and retention, run business reviews, and work on renewals and expansions. Solutions Engineer (SE): partner with our Sales team on new business—running technical discovery, product demos, proofs of concept, and answering security questionnaires and RFPs. Your deep product knowledge and customer experience from support give you a strong foundation for either path. Benefits: A dream team of highly motivated and talented people, with ambitious goals and challenges that require strong analytical and communication skills. Competitive base salary + bonuses. Office in Lisbon, Portugal, with remote work on weekends. Medical insurance. Clear career growth paths into Customer Success or Solutions Engineering. Conferences, training, certifications, and other professional development opportunities. Team-building events. Employee Wellness Program Unlimited PTO Why Spin.AI? Inc. 5000 list for 2026! 🚀 Overall Ranking: #3,309 Industry Ranking: #107 Metro Ranking: #114 State Ranking: #463 Forbes Named Spin.AI One of America's Best Startup Employers THREE Years in a Row (2024- 2026) Work in a fast-moving, high-impact cybersecurity company recognized by Gartner, Forrester, and G2 Collaborative, transparent culture - your ideas and experiments matter Direct impact: your work translates into real business growth and visibility Growth opportunities and performance-based rewards We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans.
